d: Silver-gray hair is styled with a side-swept fringe and a low ponytail, paired with sharp, light blue eyes and a stoic expression. Appearing as a young adolescent with a slender build, the figure wears a white short-sleeved collared shirt under a dark navy blue sleeveless vest, complemented by a yellow necktie and a matching dark navy blue pleated skirt. Signature details include white gloves and heavy, gray mechanical armor pieces attached to the arms and legs, featuring integrated ship turrets and cannons.
